name: Limova.ai
verdict: Brand of KAINOTOM.IA, a French SaaS start-up registered in Nice, led by co-founder Réouven Bokobza. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Premium partner of OGC Nice; the company describes itself as 'une start-up Made In France, avec une équipe basée à Nice'. Ownership above KAINOTOM.IA's two founding-related companies (BOKOBZA & CO, YD SCALING) not disclosed; no state or fund owner identified, no human-rights finding found.
